sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression on HEK293T cells confirmed; LgBit-IL12Rβ1 was functional in a BRET-based IL-23 receptor competition assay, demonstrating participation in receptor complex formation at the cell surface.
sites.rationale: IL12RB1 is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein with signal peptide 1–23 and a single extracellular N-terminus beginning at residue 24 (C). Because the signal peptide is cleaved co-translationally, any N-terminal tag must be inserted after residue 23 (the last SP residue, A) to survive to the cell surface; a tag upstream of position 24 would be cleaved off with the signal peptide. This is the only extracellular terminus, so the junction is uniquely determined from the topology landmarks (insert_after_residue = 23, residue_before = A, residue_after = C). The mature N-terminus lies 523 residues from the TM boundary (547), satisfying all distance constraints, and the published LgBit fusion (~156 aa) demonstrates that even a large protein domain is tolerated here, making a short ALFA-type tag (~15 aa) highly plausible. Full-length IL12Rβ1 was cloned into a pc3.1 zeo expression vector with an N-terminal LgBit fusion and expressed on HEK293T cells for use in a BRET-based IL-23 receptor competition assay (PMC10199020). The paper names no specific residue; it states only 'N-terminal LgBit fusion' on the full-length receptor.

sources.claim: HiBit-IL23R and LgBit-IL12Rβ1 expression vectors were created by restriction cloning IL12Rβ1 or IL23R into pc3.1 zeo expression vectors with N- terminal HiBit or LgBit fusion (kindly donated by Dr Mark Soave 44 ).

literature_notes: Only one ledger line (L1) was provided. It reports a full-length, membrane-anchored LgBit–IL12Rβ1 fusion expressed on HEK293T cells and used in a functional BRET assay, satisfying the inclusion criteria. No residue number is named in the paper, but IL12RB1 has exactly one extracellular terminus (the mature N-terminus after SP cleavage at position 23/24), so the junction is topology-derived rather than validated. No internal loop insertions, C-terminal extracellular tags, or intracellular tags are reported in the ledger. The sequence reconstruction from the numbered lines revealed a one-residue display overlap at position 181 (line 121 has 61 characters); the conflict was resolved by treating line-start numbers as authoritative and taking the first assignment, yielding the stated 662-residue sequence consistent with the topology string.
